resolutions.researcher_notes: Status inferred from context, not a literal label. (1) gx.chinanews.com.cn (2022-08-03, url_verifier PASSES live) describes 广西天然气管道有限责任公司 actively, presently supplying gas to named downstream Liuzhou retailers (柳州东城燃气, 柳州中燃) -- gas reaching Liuzhou-area users confirms an operating, in-service line into the Liuzhou/Liudong area. (2) NDRC's Dec-2023 official cross-provincial gas pipeline tariff table lists '广西LNG外输管线' (Beihai->Liuzhou) with its '柳东支线' (Liudong Branch) as a currently-tariffed national-network asset -- a shelved/non-operating line would not appear on a live tariff schedule. NOTE on the NDRC PDF: url_verifier's automated substring check FAILs on this URL (200 but token not found) -- a documented multi-column-table PDF-extraction false negative per the tool's own docstring. Downloaded the PDF and ran `pdftotext -layout` directly: line 43 reads '15  广西LNG外输管线  广西北海  广西柳州  柳东支线、粤西支线、桂林支线' -- token genuinely present, recorded ok:true on that manual-verification basis. Neither source names the 29km spur by segment specifically, so tier is medium not high.

Both sources unambiguously identify this as a natural-gas (天然气) pipeline network: the chinanews article is entirely about 天然气 transport/supply by Guangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Co Ltd (url_verifier PASSES live); the NDRC document is a national cross-provincial NATURAL GAS pipeline tariff schedule listing this exact branch (confirmed via manual `pdftotext -layout`, same PDF-extraction override noted on the Status unit). Two genuinely independent, separate-origin sources (bureau news vs. national regulator's own tariff table) agree -> high tier.

Searched extensively (Chinese) for a source confirming StartYear1=2013 as this branch's in-service/commissioning year. Found the Sinopec 广西液化天然气(LNG)项目输气管道工程竣工环境保护验收调查报告 (completion/acceptance inspection report, trqi.sinopec.com PDF) for the engineering project containing this exact 柳州支线(柳州输气站-柳东末站): the terminal/receiving-station works broke ground 2013-07-30 (trial production 2016-04), while the TRANSMISSION-PIPELINE works (主干线+柳州支线+粤西支线 together, i.e. including this branch) broke ground 2013-10-15, reached 工程中交 (construction handover) only on 2018-05-30, with final acceptance 2019-10-08. This is a POTENTIAL CONFLICT with StartYear1=2013 if that field means in-service/operational start (this source implies the pipeline engineering including this branch wasn't complete until 2018-2019) -- though it could instead SUPPORT 2013 if the field captures construction-start year (2013-10-15 is an exact-year match, but for the whole engineering project, not this branch alone). Per the standing rule against proposing a ref for a value the evidence may contradict, NOT citing this source for Start; flagging the conflict for a human/Update pass to resolve against GEM's exact StartYear1 definition. Also searched '柳州支线 2013 投产/通气' and found only China-Myanmar pipeline (中缅天然气管道) Guangxi-branch commissioning stories from Oct 2013 -- a DIFFERENT network that must not be conflated with P4718's LNG-terminal-fed network despite the coincidental '柳州支线' phrase; not used. current_ref was blank so no Wayback snapshot to check.

Same Sinopec completion inspection report supports both endpoints, more granularly than the generic city-level NDRC/chinanews sources. (1) It names this segment '柳州支线（柳州输气站-柳东末站）': start = 柳州输气站 (Liuzhou Transmission Station), end = 柳东末站 -- GEM's 'Liudong Transmission Station' corresponds to this 柳东末站 (末站 literally = terminal/end station; GEM's English rendering as 'Transmission Station' is a translation choice, not a different facility -- flagging the wording nuance transparently rather than treating it as an exact lexical match). (2) It geographically anchors the Liuzhou Transmission Station siting: the route crosses the Shankun expressway near 南渠村 (Nanqu village) then runs ~1560m east to the planned 柳州输气站; the SAME document's highway-crossing table elsewhere locates 南渠 explicitly as '柳江县洛满镇南渠' (Nanqu, Luoman Town, then-Liujiang County) -- Luoman Town is exactly GEM's recorded StartLocation town. (Administrative note, read for context only, never cited: Luoman Town was transferred from Liujiang District to Liunan District in June 2019 per zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/柳南区 -- so the source's pre-2019 '柳江县洛满镇' and GEM's current 'Luoman Town, Liunan District' describe the same physical place under sequential administrative names.) Single independent source -> tier medium.
